question: At what era and age does the prophesied time period arrive?
premises: A specific time marker is given as moon-eight-nine.
The time is located in the Śaka era.
It occurs in the Kali age.
inference: The prophesied time arrives when moon-eight-nine has passed in the Śaka era during the Kali age.
uncertainties: The numerical value of the chronogram 'indu+aṣṭa+navān' requires traditional decoding.
